## WhatsApp lead intake only
Accepts a simulated WhatsApp message payload, maps it to the canonical lead contract, and hands it to `WF02_validation_identity`.

This workflow intentionally performs no validation, contact normalization, duplicate detection, qualification, scoring, AI classification, or CRM synchronization.

The WF02 reference is name-based because n8n workflow IDs are instance-specific. After both workflows are imported, n8n may require selecting `WF02_validation_identity` once in the Execute Sub-workflow node.
